analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate social media discourse and market reactions among 10,000 Portuguese students, parents, educators, and institutions. It captures the tension between high-stakes national exams, the booming private tutoring (explicações) market, and emerging European Portuguese AI educational tools. Eight distinct operational roles reflect key stakeholders (students across cycles, parents holding purchasing power, teachers, tutors, edtech developers, schools, exam regulators, and media), grounded by Person and Organization fallback types.
